original_test_intent: Verify every expected PSU1 through PSUN input-power sensor is correctly associated with its supply and reports human-readable input watts, status and thresholds matching the approved PSU specification under the current load and redundancy state.
original_method: Enumerate all expected PSU input-power channels and immutable raw/UI identities, collect complete watts/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized presence, health, redundancy, input voltage/current and system-load context, and compare each raw and WebUI value to the owner specification.
manual_activity: The owner provides PSU topology, input-power unit/range/threshold and redundancy/load expectations; an operator verifies raw/UI correlation and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and installed PSU slot/model inventory
Physical PSU slot to SDR/Redfish/UI input-power mapping
Input-watt unit/scale/thresholds, rated range and sampling behavior
Read-only PSU presence/health/redundancy, input voltage/current and system-load context
UI refresh/rounding tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep access read-only; never change PSU redundancy, thresholds, load or power controls
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind every measurement to a physical PSU and synchronized electrical/load context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on missing/failed supply, voltage/current inconsistency, implausible watts, alarm or mapping fault
Do not change load or PSU state merely to obtain a preferred reading
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify the complete PSU input-power population and physical mappings
Collect full raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps plus read-only context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/rounding normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, electrical inconsistency or raw/UI/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no PSU/power mutation or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative PSU mapping, input-power specification and redundancy/load tolerances
Review electrical, raw/UI and context discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool may provide a raw source, but a literal PSU1~N name and head-limited fallback do not prove every physical PSU, complete thresholds, UI presentation or input electrical/load context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate the complete SDR/Redfish PSU inventory, select all owner-mapped input-power records, capture full metadata and synchronized presence/health/redundancy/voltage/current/load context, then correlate WebUI rows to the specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PSU1~N_Input_W scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED PSU INPUT-POWER POPULATION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-PSU matrix of slot/model identity, input watts/unit/status/threshold, presence/health/redundancy/voltage/current/load context and UI display, with completeness and specification results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical supply and AC-input context while replacing insecure/truncated generic reads and log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One PSU value or screenshot cannot cover PSU1..N or prove correct slot association. Every installed/expected supply and its input channel must be reconciled.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Redundant supplies may share load unevenly or enter standby, and sensor sampling may not equal instantaneous volts times amps; project policy defines acceptable behavior.

project_override_considerations: If a standby or absent PSU legitimately reports zero/not-present, the owner must define expected state-specific treatment; do not infer input power from the separate output-watts row.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/PSU topology/spec revision
Per-PSU slot/model to raw/UI input-power identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved electrical/sampling/rounding comparison
Per-PSU discrepancies, no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target PSU input-watts readings and thresholds. Exact slot association and redundancy/load expectations are project inputs, not contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: PSU mapping/specification, complete raw/UI data and electrical/load context gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Defines complete per-supply AC/input-power evidence and contextual plausibility rather than accepting a family-name sensor response.
independent_technical_reasoning: Input power depends on system demand, efficiency mode and load sharing, so a watt reading is only meaningful with PSU slot, presence, redundancy and input electrical context. A standby unit may legitimately differ from an active peer, while a plausible number attached to the wrong slot is still invalid. Output watts can support an efficiency sanity check but cannot replace the input-side measurement because conversion losses separate the two domains.
